name: update-tobacco-catalog
title_zh: 新草上市先查重再进目录的烟斗客助手
tagline_zh: 厂商和零售店刚挂出的新调配，你还在手动比对？它自动核对老目录，保留出处和旧条目，只把没收录的加进去。
tagline_en: Tired of manually matching new blends against your old list? It cross-checks manufacturer and retailer sources.
desc_en: Research new pipe-tobacco releases and update Tin to Cellar's names-only autocomplete catalog. Use when asked to refresh the catalog, add newly released blends, or reconcile names from manufacturer and retailer sources with the existing catalog. Preserves provenance, historical entries, and reviewed deduplication.
why_zh: 内置人工复核过的去重逻辑，不会把历史条目或同款异名当新品重复入库。
why_en: Built-in dedup logic from human review means no duplicate entries for historical items or aliases.
limit_zh: 只维护名称自动补全目录，不含价格、评分或品吸笔记；需联网访问厂商与零售源，且源站改版时可能需人工调整解析规则。
limit_en: Only updates the names-only autocomplete catalog; no prices, ratings, or tasting notes. Needs internet access; site redesigns may require manual.
title_en: New pipe tobacco releases checked and deduped into your.
